blocks.text: Ecosystem mein jandar khane ke lehaaz se mukhtalif groups mein tarteeb diye jate hain; in groups ko trophic levels (ghizai darje) kehte hain.

items: Trophic level 1 mein sabz paude, algae aur photosynthetic bacteria hain. Yeh ecosystem ke primary producers (khuraak banane wale) hain.
Trophic level 2 mein primary consumers (herbivores, sabzi khor) hain jo seedha producers ko khate hain, maslan keere aur khargosh.
Trophic level 3 mein secondary consumers (carnivores, gosht khor) aur janwaron ke parasites (tufaili) hain jo herbivores ko khate hain, maslan mendak aur saanp.
Trophic level 4 mein tertiary consumers (gosht khoron ko khane wale janwar) hain, maslan bheriya (wolf) aur baaz (hawk).

Decomposers aur detritivores (kekre, gidh aur gidar) ek alag trophic level banate hain. Yeh tamam trophic levels se khuraak lete hain. Yeh detritus (murda, galte sarte paudon aur janwaron ka maadda) aur fuzla (fecal matter) khate hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar tasveerein upar tale, narangi teeron se jurin: trophic level 1, fern; level 2, tidda (grasshopper); level 3, chooha; level 4, uqaab. Suraj se peela teer level 1 tak. Har level se patle teer decomposers ke gulabi daire (khumbi, bacteria aur doosre jaraseem) tak jaate hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab kekron, gidhon aur gidaron ko decomposers aur detritivores ki misaal kehti hai. Aam taur par yeh janwar detritivores ya murdar khor (scavengers) kehlate hain; asal decomposers zyada tar bacteria aur fungi hain jo murda maadde ko tor kar nutrients mitti mein wapas karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Khargosh kis trophic level par hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Trophic level 2 par, kyun ke yeh primary consumer (herbivore) hai jo seedha producers (paude) khata hai.

items: Level 1: producers (sabz paude, algae, photosynthetic bacteria); level 2: herbivores (keere, khargosh).
Level 3: carnivores aur parasites (mendak, saanp); level 4: tertiary consumers (bheriya, baaz).
Decomposers aur detritivores alag level hain aur tamam levels se khuraak lete hain.
